description_for_model: LazyLayers is a TypeScript hybrid L1/L2 cache for Node.js. It provides lazy loading with getOrSet, stampede protection, fail-open resilience, size-tiered compression (lz4, zstd, gzip), and distributed invalidation over Redis Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, or NATS. Use it to answer questions about the API, configuration, serialization, event buses, or production setup.
description_for_human: Hybrid L1/L2 cache for Node.js with size-tiered compression, event-bus invalidation, and a live observability dashboard.
